words.image_desc_en: Two apples side by side on a wooden table, one red and one green, with a measuring tape between them

words.usage: v. (过去式 compared, 过去分词 compared)
words.collocations: compare A with B, compare A to B

examples.en: I often compare my test scores with my best friend's.
examples.cn: 我经常把我的考试成绩和我最好朋友的比较。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to compare the two poems in class.
examples.cn: 老师让我们在课堂上比较这两首诗。

socratic_questions.question: 你想知道两本词典哪本更好，你会做什么动作？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作是把两个东西放在一起看异同，就是‘比较’的意思。

sentences: Please ___ your answers with your partner's before handing in.

image_prompts: A small kitten hiding behind a large green plant pot, only its tail visible
A closed book with a bookmark sticking out, placed on a quiet library desk in soft sunlight
words.image_desc_en: A small kitten hiding behind a large green plant pot, only its tail visible
words.image_desc_cn: 一只小猫躲在大绿植花盆后面，只露出尾巴
words.usage: adj. (比较级 shyer, 最高级 shyest)
words.collocations: feel shy, too shy to do, shy smile

examples.en: She felt too shy to speak in front of the class.
examples.cn: 她太害羞了，不敢在全班面前发言。

examples.en: The new student gave a shy wave from the back row.
examples.cn: 新来的学生从后排害羞地挥了挥手。

socratic_questions.question: 你第一次上台演讲时，心跳很快，不敢看观众，这种状态叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种紧张、不敢表现自己的感觉，就是‘害羞’。

sentences: My little sister is too ___ to order food by herself.

image_prompts: A cat curled up sleeping on a pile of unopened books under a desk lamp
A half-finished homework sheet lying on a messy desk next to a smartphone with a game screen
words.image_desc_en: A cat curled up sleeping on a pile of unopened books under a desk lamp
words.image_desc_cn: 一只猫蜷缩在一堆未打开的书上睡觉，台灯下
words.usage: adj. (比较级 lazier, 最高级 laziest; 副词 lazily)
words.collocations: lazy afternoon, lazy habit, too lazy to do

examples.en: He is too lazy to clean his room on weekends.
examples.cn: 他太懒了，周末都不打扫房间。

examples.en: A lazy cat slept on the sofa all afternoon.
examples.cn: 一只懒猫在沙发上睡了一整个下午。

socratic_questions.question: 周末你只想躺着玩手机，不想写作业，这种状态用一个词形容是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 不想动、不想做事，就是‘懒惰’的表现。

sentences: Don't be so ___; finish your homework before dinner.

image_prompts: A red alarm clock ringing on a bedside table with visible sound waves drawn around it
A construction site with a yellow jackhammer hitting concrete, dust flying up
words.image_desc_en: A red alarm clock ringing on a bedside table with visible sound waves drawn around it
words.image_desc_cn: 红色闹钟在床头柜上响着，周围画有可见的声波
words.usage: adj. (比较级 louder, 最高级 loudest; 副词 loudly)
words.collocations: loud music, loud voice, loud noise

examples.en: The loud music from the party kept me awake all night.
examples.cn: 派对上吵闹的音乐让我整晚睡不着。

examples.en: Please speak in a loud voice so everyone can hear you.
examples.cn: 请大声说话，这样每个人都能听到你。

socratic_questions.question: 图书馆里有人大声打电话，你会用什么词形容他的声音？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 声音很大、很吵，就是‘大声的’。

sentences: The ___ thunder scared the dog under the bed.

image_prompts: A rain gauge on a wooden post showing 50 mm of water after a heavy storm, surrounded by wet grass
A puddle on a dirt road with ripples from falling raindrops, dark clouds in the sky
words.image_desc_en: A rain gauge filled with water after a storm, with wet grass around it.
words.image_desc_cn: 暴雨后装满水的雨量计，周围是湿漉漉的草地。
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: heavy rainfall, annual rainfall, average rainfall
words.preposition_combos: rainfall in (地区/月份), rainfall of (数量)

examples.en: The annual rainfall in this city is about 800 mm.
examples.cn: 这个城市的年降雨量约为800毫米。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall caused the river to rise quickly.
examples.cn: 强降雨导致河水迅速上涨。

socratic_questions.question: 气象预报说今天会有很多雨水，你想知道具体下了多少毫米，应该查什么数据？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指降水的总量，不是雨滴本身，而是测量出的数值。

sentences: The ___ in July was much higher than last year.

image_prompts: A speed limit sign on a road showing '60 km per hour' with a blurred car in the background
A grocery store shelf with a price tag reading '$2 per kilogram' on a bag of apples
words.image_desc_en: A speed limit sign indicating 60 kilometers per hour on a roadside.
words.image_desc_cn: 路边限速标志，显示每小时60公里。
words.usage: prep. (介词)
words.collocations: per day, per person, per hour, per cent

examples.en: The ticket costs $10 per person for the show.
examples.cn: 这场演出的门票每人10美元。

examples.en: We can finish about five math problems per minute.
examples.cn: 我们每分钟大约能完成五道数学题。

socratic_questions.question: 你想知道每个学生需要交多少活动费，老师告诉你一个数字，这个数字是按什么单位计算的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示‘每个’，后面常跟时间或人数单位。

sentences: The bus can carry 50 passengers ___ trip.

image_prompts: A close-up of a wooden ruler showing the millimeter scale from 0 to 10 mm, with a pencil tip at 5 mm
A stack of 10 coins on a flat surface, with a label '10 mm total thickness' next to them
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a ruler showing millimeter markings with a pencil tip at 5 mm.
words.image_desc_cn: 尺子毫米刻度的特写，铅笔尖停在5毫米处。
words.usage: n. (缩写，可数名词，单复数同形)
words.collocations: 10 mm, a few mm, mm of rain
words.preposition_combos: mm in length, mm of (物质)

examples.en: The pencil is 7 mm thick and 150 mm long.
examples.cn: 这支铅笔粗7毫米，长150毫米。

examples.en: Only 2 mm of rain fell during the whole week.
examples.cn: 整个星期只下了2毫米的雨。

socratic_questions.question: 科学课上老师让你测量一片树叶的厚度，你用尺子发现它不到1厘米，应该用什么更小的单位记录？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是‘毫米’的缩写，比厘米小，常用于精确测量。

sentences: The insect's body is only 5 ___ long.

image_prompts: A digital caliper measuring a thin metal wire, display showing 0.5 millimeter
A stack of 100 sheets of paper with a label '10 millimeters' on a desk, next to a ruler
words.image_desc_en: A digital caliper measuring a thin wire, with the display showing 0.5 millimeter.
words.image_desc_cn: 数显卡尺测量一根细金属丝，显示屏显示0.5毫米。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 millimeters)
words.collocations: one millimeter, a few millimeters, millimeter by millimeter
words.preposition_combos: millimeter in diameter, millimeter of (物质)

examples.en: The screw is 3 millimeters in diameter and 20 long.
examples.cn: 这颗螺丝直径3毫米，长20毫米。

examples.en: Move the camera just one millimeter to the left.
examples.cn: 把相机向左移动仅仅一毫米。

socratic_questions.question: 组装模型时，零件需要精确到很小的长度单位，厘米太大，应该用什么单位？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是‘毫米’的全称，比厘米小10倍，用于精细测量。

sentences: The gap between the two parts is less than one ___.

image_prompts: A bright sunny day with a clear blue sky, green grass, and a single white daisy in the foreground, soft natural lighting
A cup of hot tea on a wooden table next to an open book, steam rising gently, warm golden hour light
words.image_desc_en: A sunny meadow with a single daisy, or a steaming tea cup beside an open book in warm light.
words.image_desc_cn: 阳光明媚的草地上有一朵雏菊，或一杯热茶旁放着一本打开的书，光线温暖。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 pleasanter / more pleasant, 最高级 pleasantest / most pleasant)
words.collocations: pleasant weather, pleasant experience, pleasant smile, pleasant voice
words.preposition_combos: pleasant to someone, pleasant for someone

examples.en: The weather today is very pleasant for a picnic.
examples.cn: 今天的天气非常适合野餐。

examples.en: She has a pleasant voice that makes everyone calm.
examples.cn: 她有一副令人愉快的嗓音，让每个人都平静下来。

socratic_questions.question: 你周末去公园散步，阳光温暖，微风拂面，鸟语花香。你会用什么词形容这种感受？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述让人感到舒适、开心、放松的环境或事物，不是‘美丽’或‘有趣’，而是‘舒服’。

sentences: The garden looks very ___ with all the colorful flowers.

image_prompts: Two apples side by side on a wooden table, one red and one green, with a small arrow pointing between them
A ruler measuring two pencils of different lengths on a white desk, clear contrast in size
words.image_desc_en: A red apple and a green apple with an arrow between them, or a ruler comparing two pencils of different lengths.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个红苹果和一个绿苹果，中间有箭头；或一把尺子测量两支不同长度的铅笔。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 differences)
words.collocations: make a difference, tell the difference, big difference, cultural difference
words.preposition_combos: difference between A and B, difference in something

examples.en: Can you tell the difference between these two pictures?
examples.cn: 你能看出这两幅画的不同之处吗？

examples.en: A small effort can make a big difference to the environment.
examples.cn: 一个小小的努力可以对环境产生很大的不同。

socratic_questions.question: 你面前有两支笔，一支蓝色一支红色，长度也不一样。你要怎么描述它们之间的关系？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词强调两者之间‘不一样’的地方，不是‘相同’或‘相似’。

sentences: There is a big ___ between summer and winter in this city.

image_prompts: Two identical white coffee mugs on a shelf, same shape and size, side by side
A pair of matching sneakers placed neatly on a shoe rack, both white with blue stripes
words.image_desc_en: Two identical white mugs on a shelf, or a pair of matching sneakers with blue stripes.
words.image_desc_cn: 两个一模一样的白色马克杯放在架子上，或一双带有蓝色条纹的匹配运动鞋。
words.usage: adj. (只作表语，不作定语) / adv.
words.collocations: look alike, treat alike, think alike, very alike

examples.en: The two houses look so alike that I often get lost.
examples.cn: 这两栋房子看起来太像了，我经常迷路。

examples.en: All the books on this shelf are alike in color.
examples.cn: 这个架子上所有的书颜色都一样。

socratic_questions.question: 你看到两片树叶，形状和颜色几乎一模一样，很难区分。你会怎么形容它们？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示‘非常相像’，但不是‘相同’（same），也不是‘不同’（different）。

sentences: The twins are so ___ that their teacher cannot tell them apart.

image_prompts: A rectangular mirror hanging on a white wall, reflecting a window with sunlight streaming in
A small round mirror on a wooden dressing table, reflecting a vase of fresh flowers
words.image_desc_en: A rectangular mirror reflecting a sunny window, or a round mirror reflecting a vase of flowers on a table.
words.image_desc_cn: 一面长方形镜子反射出阳光明媚的窗户，或一面圆镜反射出桌上的花瓶。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 mirrors) / v. (过去式 mirrored, 过去分词 mirrored)
words.collocations: look in the mirror, rearview mirror, mirror image, mirror one's feelings
words.preposition_combos: mirror of something, mirror in something

examples.en: She checked her hair in the mirror before leaving home.
examples.cn: 她在离家前照镜子检查了头发。

examples.en: The calm lake mirrors the blue sky perfectly.
examples.cn: 平静的湖面完美地映照出蓝天。

socratic_questions.question: 早上你站在一个光滑的玻璃前，看到自己的脸。这个玻璃叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指能照出影像的平面物体，不是窗户，也不是照片。

sentences: The lake is so clear that it acts like a ___ for the mountains.

image_prompts: A stack of colorful science magazines on a wooden desk, a magnifying glass resting on top
A chessboard with pieces mid-game, soft sunlight from a window illuminating the board
words.image_desc_en: A stack of colorful science magazines on a wooden desk with a magnifying glass on top.
words.image_desc_cn: 一叠彩色科学杂志放在木桌上，上面放着一个放大镜。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 interested, 过去分词 interested)
words.collocations: take an interest in, have no interest in, be interested in

examples.en: She takes a great interest in reading science fiction books.
examples.cn: 她对阅读科幻小说有浓厚的兴趣。

examples.en: His new hobby of painting interests many of his classmates.
examples.cn: 他画画的新爱好让很多同学感兴趣。

socratic_questions.question: 小明周末总喜欢去图书馆看恐龙百科，一坐就是两小时。他为什么能这么专注？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示对某事物感到好奇或喜欢，常与'in'搭配使用。

sentences: She has a strong ___ in learning how to play the guitar.

image_prompts: A hardcover book with a bookmark sticking out, lying on a park bench under autumn leaves
A typewriter with a half-typed page, a cup of coffee beside it on a wooden table
words.image_desc_en: A hardcover book with a bookmark sticking out, lying on a park bench under autumn leaves.
words.image_desc_cn: 一本带书签的精装书放在公园长椅上，上方有秋叶飘落。
words.usage: n. / adj.
words.collocations: read a novel, a popular novel, a novel idea

examples.en: This novel about a time traveler is very popular at school.
examples.cn: 这本关于时间旅行者的小说在学校很受欢迎。

examples.en: The teacher praised her novel way to solve the math problem.
examples.cn: 老师表扬了她解决数学问题的新颖方法。

socratic_questions.question: 语文老师推荐了一本课外读物，里面讲了一个侦探破案的故事，这本书叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词可以指一种虚构的文学作品，也可以形容想法很新。

sentences: I borrowed a science fiction ___ from the school library yesterday.

image_prompts: A kitchen counter with a lemon cut in half, steam rising from a hot cup of tea
A compass on a map with a red arrow pointing north, a pencil marking a route
words.image_desc_en: A kitchen counter with a lemon cut in half and steam rising from a hot cup of tea.
words.image_desc_cn: 厨房台面上有半个柠檬，一杯热茶冒着蒸汽。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 sensed, 过去分词 sensed)
words.collocations: a sense of humor, common sense, make sense

examples.en: A good sense of direction helps you find your way easily.
examples.cn: 好的方向感能帮你轻松找到路。

examples.en: She sensed something wrong when the lights went out suddenly.
examples.cn: 当灯突然熄灭时，她感觉到有些不对劲。

socratic_questions.question: 小丽闻到厨房飘来烤蛋糕的香味，她知道妈妈在做好吃的。这是哪种能力？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词可以指五官的感觉，也可以指对某事的判断力。

sentences: It doesn't ___ to stay up too late before an exam.

image_prompts: A cartoon strip on a newspaper page with a laughing emoji drawn in the margin
A banana peel lying on a sidewalk next to a red clown nose
words.image_desc_en: A cartoon strip on a newspaper page with a laughing emoji drawn in the margin.
words.image_desc_cn: 报纸上的一幅连环漫画，页边空白处画了一个大笑的表情符号。
words.usage: n.
words.collocations: sense of humour, black humour, dry humour

examples.en: His sense of humour always makes the class laugh happily.
examples.cn: 他的幽默感总是让全班开心大笑。

examples.en: There is a lot of humour in this funny comic book.
examples.cn: 这本有趣的漫画书里有很多幽默元素。

socratic_questions.question: 班里有个同学讲笑话总能逗大家笑，大家说他很有这种品质。是什么品质？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指让人发笑的能力或特质，常与'sense of'搭配。

sentences: My best friend has a great sense of ___ and tells funny jokes.

image_prompts: A bright red fire truck parked in front of a burning house with water spraying, fire nearly out, smoke clearing, thanks to firefighters' equipment
A green plant growing tall under a sunlamp with a water dropper nearby, soil moist, leaves vibrant, thanks to artificial light and water
words.image_desc_en: A fire truck with water spraying on a house fire, smoke clearing, showing rescue success due to equipment.
words.image_desc_cn: 一辆消防车向着火房屋喷水，烟雾散去，显示因设备而成功救援。
words.meaning_cn: 幸亏；由于（表示原因，常指积极结果）
words.usage: 介词短语 prep. phrase（后接名词或名词短语）
words.collocations: thanks to your help, thanks to the rain, thanks to hard work

examples.en: Thanks to the map, we found the park easily.
examples.cn: 多亏了地图，我们轻松找到了公园。

examples.en: Thanks to your advice, I passed the exam.
examples.cn: 多亏了你的建议，我通过了考试。

socratic_questions.question: 小明考试没复习，但同桌借给他笔记，他考了高分。你想说“因为同桌的帮助，他成功了”，用哪个短语？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示“由于……（积极原因）”，后面直接跟名词，比如“thanks to his classmate's help”。

sentences: ___ the early bus, we arrived on time.

image_prompts: A white speech bubble with a question mark inside, floating above a wooden table with two different colored pencils pointing at it
A scale with a red book on one side and a blue book on the other, both balanced, representing different views
words.image_desc_en: A speech bubble with a question mark above a table, two colored pencils pointing at it, symbolizing different viewpoints.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个带问号的气泡浮在桌子上方，两支彩色铅笔指向它，象征不同观点。
words.usage: 名词 n. (复数 opinions)
words.collocations: in my opinion, give an opinion, share opinions, have a different opinion

examples.en: In my opinion, this movie is very interesting.
examples.cn: 在我看来，这部电影非常有趣。

examples.en: We should listen to everyone's opinion in class.
examples.cn: 在课堂上我们应该听取每个人的意见。

socratic_questions.question: 老师问大家对春游地点的想法，你想说“我觉得去植物园好”，但需要先表达“我的看法是……”，用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是名词，表示“看法、观点”，常用短语“in my opinion”开头。

sentences: ___ my ___, reading books is more useful than watching TV.

image_prompts: A crumpled piece of paper with red ink crossing out a math equation on a wooden desk, an eraser nearby
A broken pencil tip lying on a notebook with a misspelled word written in blue ink, a correction tape beside it
words.image_desc_en: A crumpled paper with a crossed-out math equation in red ink, an eraser on a wooden desk, showing an error.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张皱巴巴的纸上用红笔划掉数学算式，橡皮放在木桌上，显示错误。
words.usage: 动词短语 v. phrase (过去式 made a mistake, 过去分词 made a mistake)
words.collocations: make a spelling mistake, make a silly mistake, learn from mistakes

examples.en: I made a mistake in the math test yesterday.
examples.cn: 我昨天在数学考试中犯了一个错误。
每个人都会在生活中犯错误。
examples.en: Everyone can make a mistake in life.

socratic_questions.question: 你写作文时把“their”写成了“there”，老师批改时画了圈。这个行为叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一个动词短语，表示“出错”，由“make”和“a mistake”组成。

sentences: Don't be afraid to ___ ___ ___ when learning English.

image_prompts: A half-empty glass of water on a table next to a full glass, sunlight casting shadows, showing less water
A small pile of three coins next to a large pile of twenty coins on a wooden surface, contrast in quantity
words.image_desc_en: A half-empty glass of water beside a full glass, sunlight shadows, illustrating a smaller amount.
words.image_desc_cn: 半杯水放在满杯水旁边，阳光投下阴影，表示更少的量。
words.usage: 形容词 adj. (little的比较级) / 副词 adv.
words.collocations: less time, less money, less sugar, less than, more or less

examples.en: You should eat less sugar to stay healthy.
examples.cn: 你应该少吃糖来保持健康。

examples.en: He spent less time on games this week.
examples.cn: 这周他花在游戏上的时间更少了。

socratic_questions.question: 医生建议你少喝可乐，因为可乐含糖太多。你想表达“喝更少的可乐”，用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是“little”的比较级，表示“更少的”，修饰不可数名词。

sentences: To save money, we should spend ___ on snacks.

image_prompts: A red stop sign with bold white letters 'ADV' painted on a wooden post in a sunny park
A dictionary open to a page with the word 'adv' highlighted in yellow marker, next to a pencil
words.image_desc_en: A red stop sign with bold white letters 'ADV' painted on a wooden post in a sunny park
words.image_desc_cn: 一个红色停车标志，上面用粗体白字写着“ADV”，立在阳光明媚的公园里的木柱上
words.usage: n. (缩写) 副词
words.collocations: adv. of time, adv. of place, adv. of manner

examples.en: The teacher asked us to find an adv in the sentence.
examples.cn: 老师让我们在句子中找一个副词。

image_prompts: A shiny gold medal with a red ribbon lying on an open wooden box, soft spotlight above
A blue ribbon tied around a large book with 'First Place' printed on the cover
words.usage: n. (可数名词) / v. (过去式 prized, 过去分词 prized)
words.collocations: win a prize, first prize, prize money, prize for

examples.en: She won the first prize in the school art competition.
examples.cn: 她在学校艺术比赛中获得了一等奖。

examples.en: The prize for the best essay is a new bicycle.
examples.cn: 最佳作文的奖品是一辆新自行车。

socratic_questions.question: 学校举办了一场英语演讲比赛，你获得了第一名，学校会给你一个什么东西作为奖励？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指在比赛或竞赛中因表现优异而获得的奖励，可以是奖杯、奖牌或物品。

sentences: He was happy to ___ the first ___ in the science fair.

image_prompts: An empty classroom with desks arranged neatly and a clock showing 8:00 AM, sunlight through window
A concert hall with rows of empty red seats and a stage with musical instruments set up
words.usage: v. (过去式 attended, 过去分词 attended)
words.collocations: attend school, attend a meeting, attend a concert, attend class

examples.en: All students must attend the morning assembly every day.
examples.cn: 所有学生必须每天参加晨会。

examples.en: I will attend a summer camp next month.
examples.cn: 下个月我将参加一个夏令营。

socratic_questions.question: 明天下午三点学校有一个重要的讲座，老师要求每个同学都要去，用哪个词表示'去参加'？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词强调正式地出现在某个活动或场所，比如上课、开会、听讲座。

sentences: How many students will ___ the sports meeting tomorrow?

image_prompts: A wooden table with three apples and one orange next to them, a note saying 'fruit basket'
A shelf with five books standing and two more books lying flat on top, library background
words.usage: prep. / adv.
words.collocations: besides this, besides that, besides doing sth.

examples.en: Besides English, we also study math and science.
examples.cn: 除了英语，我们还学习数学和科学。

examples.en: Besides playing basketball, he enjoys reading novels.
examples.cn: 除了打篮球，他还喜欢读小说。

socratic_questions.question: 你周末除了做作业，还打算去游泳和看电影。你想表达'除了作业之外还有别的活动'，该用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示'包括在内'的附加，即除了提到的内容，还有另外的内容。注意它和'except'（排除在外）的区别。

sentences: ___ singing, she is also good at dancing and painting.

image_prompts: A single spare tire leaning against a garage wall, rubber texture visible
A spare key hanging on a small hook by a wooden door, metal glint
words.image_desc_en: A spare tire against a wall; a spare key on a hook.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个备用轮胎靠在墙上；一把备用钥匙挂在钩子上。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的
words.usage: adj. (无词形变化)
words.collocations: spare time, spare key, spare tire, spare room

examples.en: I keep a spare umbrella in my schoolbag every day.
examples.cn: 我每天在书包里放一把备用雨伞。

examples.en: Do you have a spare pen for the math exam?
examples.cn: 你有多余的笔用于数学考试吗？

socratic_questions.question: 你的笔突然没墨了，你希望同桌有什么东西可以借给你？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示‘额外的、备用的’，不是‘新的’或‘旧的’。

sentences: Could you lend me a ___ pencil? I broke mine.

image_prompts: An open book on a sunny windowsill with a cup of tea beside it, soft afternoon light
A chessboard with pieces mid-game on a wooden table, no players visible
words.image_desc_en: A book and tea on a windowsill; a chessboard with pieces.
words.image_desc_cn: 窗台上的书和茶；一盘下到一半的国际象棋。
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: in one's spare time, spend spare time, use spare time

examples.en: She reads science fiction in her spare time at home.
examples.cn: 她在家的空闲时间读科幻小说。

examples.en: I use my spare time to practice English listening skills.
examples.cn: 我利用空闲时间练习英语听力技巧。

socratic_questions.question: 放学后写完作业，到睡觉前这段时间，你可以做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词组指‘不用上课或做作业的时间’，不是‘上课时间’。

sentences: He enjoys painting in his ___.

image_prompts: A plate of freshly baked chocolate chip cookies on a cooling rack, steam rising
A cozy armchair with a soft blanket and a stack of colorful magazines
words.image_desc_en: Fresh cookies with steam; a cozy armchair with magazines.
words.image_desc_cn: 冒着热气的新鲜饼干；舒适的扶手椅和杂志。
words.usage: n. (可数/不可数名词)
words.collocations: with pleasure, a great pleasure, reading pleasure

examples.en: It is a great pleasure to help my classmates with math.
examples.cn: 帮助同学学数学是一件很快乐的事。

examples.en: She finds pleasure in listening to light music after exams.
examples.cn: 她在考试后从听轻音乐中找到快乐。

socratic_questions.question: 你帮朋友捡起掉落的书，朋友说谢谢，你该怎么礼貌回答？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示‘愉快’，常用于礼貌回应，不是‘没问题’或‘不客气’的直译。

sentences: Thank you for your help! — It's my ___.

image_prompts: Two identical blue notebooks placed side by side on a desk, same cover design
Two bicycles of the same model and color parked next to each other in a rack
words.image_desc_en: Two identical notebooks; two same-model bicycles.
words.image_desc_cn: 两本相同的笔记本；两辆同款自行车。
words.usage: v. (短语动词，have 的过去式 had，过去分词 had)
words.collocations: have a lot in common, have nothing in common, have something in common with
words.preposition_combos: have ... in common with (与…有共同点)

examples.en: The two clubs have a lot in common about environmental protection.
examples.cn: 这两个俱乐部在环保方面有很多共同点。

examples.en: I have nothing in common with that boring science project.
examples.cn: 我和那个无聊的科学项目毫无共同之处。

socratic_questions.question: 你和你的好朋友都喜欢打篮球和听流行音乐，这说明你们之间有什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示‘共享相同的兴趣或特点’，不是‘一起做某事’。

sentences: My sister and I ___ a lot in common: we both love cats.

image_prompts: A neatly folded school uniform on a wooden hanger against a white wall, bright daylight
A clean white sneaker placed next to a muddy one on a doormat, contrasting textures
words.image_desc_en: A neatly folded school uniform on a hanger and a clean sneaker next to a muddy one.
words.image_desc_cn: 一件整齐叠好的校服挂在衣架上，以及一只干净的运动鞋放在一只脏鞋旁边。
words.usage: n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: physical appearance, outward appearance, change one's appearance

examples.en: Her appearance at the party surprised all her friends.
examples.cn: 她在派对上的出现让所有朋友都感到惊讶。

examples.en: The appearance of the old library changed after the rain.
examples.cn: 雨后旧图书馆的外观发生了变化。

socratic_questions.question: 你第一次见到新同学时，最先注意到的是他的长相还是性格？哪个词描述的是“长相”？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指一个人或物体的外部样子，不是内在品质。

sentences: The ___ of the building is very modern and clean.

image_prompts: A colorful jigsaw puzzle with one piece missing on a wooden table, soft lighting
A bright sunflower standing alone in a field of green grass, blue sky background
words.image_desc_en: A colorful jigsaw puzzle with a missing piece and a single sunflower in a green field.
words.image_desc_cn: 一块缺了一片的彩色拼图，以及一片绿草地中独自挺立的向日葵。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，通常单数)
words.collocations: strong personality, friendly personality, develop one's personality

examples.en: A good personality is more important than good looks.
examples.cn: 好的性格比好看的外貌更重要。

examples.en: My best friend has a warm and cheerful personality.
examples.cn: 我最好的朋友性格温暖又开朗。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要描述一个人是否友善、幽默或安静，你是在说他的外貌还是性格？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是一个人的内在特质，比如是否开朗或认真。

sentences: Her ___ makes her very popular in the class.

image_prompts: A closed textbook with a pair of glasses on top, on a desk under a desk lamp
A chessboard with pieces in mid-game, no players visible, focused composition
words.image_desc_en: A closed textbook with glasses on a desk and a chessboard mid-game.
words.image_desc_cn: 一本合上的课本上放着眼镜，以及一盘进行中的国际象棋。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 more serious, 最高级 most serious)
words.collocations: serious problem, serious expression, serious about

examples.en: The teacher gave a serious warning about the exam.
examples.cn: 老师对考试给出了严肃的警告。

examples.en: He is serious about learning English this year.
examples.cn: 他今年对学英语很认真。

socratic_questions.question: 当老师提到中考时，他的表情变得很严肃，不再开玩笑。哪个词能形容这种表情？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示不轻松、不搞笑，带有认真或重要的意味。

sentences: The doctor looked ___ when he read the test results.

image_prompts: A stack of heavy dumbbells on a gym floor, metal texture, bright light
A thick tree trunk with visible roots gripping the ground, forest background
words.image_desc_en: A stack of heavy dumbbells on a gym floor and a thick tree trunk with roots.
words.image_desc_cn: 一堆沉重的哑铃放在健身房地板上，以及一棵粗壮的树干和露出的树根。
words.usage: n. (不可数名词，可作可数名词表示“优点”)
words.collocations: physical strength, inner strength, strengths and weaknesses

examples.en: Regular exercise can improve your physical strength.
examples.cn: 定期锻炼能提高你的体力。

examples.en: One of her strengths is solving math problems quickly.
examples.cn: 她的优点之一是快速解数学题。

socratic_questions.question: 举重运动员需要什么才能举起很重的杠铃？这个词也指一个人擅长的方面。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词既指体力上的力气，也指能力上的长处。

sentences: Swimming is a good way to build up your ___.

image_prompts: A slim silver laptop lying open on a wooden desk, thin edge visible
A slim glass bottle of water next to a single green leaf on a white table
words.image_desc_en: A slim laptop on a desk; a slim water bottle beside a leaf.
words.image_desc_cn: 一台纤薄的笔记本电脑放在桌上；一个细长的水瓶旁边有一片叶子。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 苗条的；薄的；微小的（机会等）
words.usage: adj. (比较级 slimmer, 最高级 slimmest)
words.collocations: slim chance, slim figure, slim book
words.preposition_combos: slim in size, slim for a notebook

examples.en: She has a slim chance to win the race.
examples.cn: 她赢得比赛的机会很小。

examples.en: This slim dictionary fits easily in my bag.
examples.cn: 这本薄词典很容易放进我的包里。

socratic_questions.question: 你想描述一本很薄、不占空间的书，应该用哪个形容词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示厚度小或身材纤细，常用来形容物品或体型。

sentences: The ___ phone can slide into a small pocket.

image_prompts: A stack of books with a magnifying glass on top, a paper labeled 'Fact' sticking out
A chalkboard with the word 'Fact' written in white chalk, an eraser nearby
words.image_desc_en: Books with a magnifying glass and a 'Fact' label; a chalkboard with the word 'Fact'.
words.image_desc_cn: 一堆书和放大镜，上面有写着‘事实’的标签；黑板上写着‘事实’二字。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 facts)
words.collocations: in fact, as a matter of fact, hard fact

examples.en: In fact, the sun rises in the east.
examples.cn: 事实上，太阳从东方升起。

examples.en: Check the fact before you write the report.
examples.cn: 写报告前先核实事实。

socratic_questions.question: 你想强调某件事是真实存在的，不是猜测，应该用哪个名词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指客观存在或已被证明的真实信息。

sentences: It is a ___ that water freezes at zero degrees.

image_prompts: A city skyline at night with thousands of tiny glowing windows, a sign reading 'Population'
A dense crowd of ants on a tree trunk, forming a line, with a small label 'Population'
words.image_desc_en: City skyline with glowing windows and a 'Population' sign; ants on a tree trunk labeled 'Population'.
words.image_desc_cn: 城市天际线亮着窗户，有‘人口’标志；树干上的蚂蚁群标有‘种群’字样。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，常与 the 连用)
words.collocations: large population, population growth, population of

examples.en: The population of this town is about ten thousand.
examples.cn: 这个城镇的人口大约有一万。

examples.en: A large population needs more schools and hospitals.
examples.cn: 大量人口需要更多的学校和医院。

socratic_questions.question: 你想说一个城市里住着多少人，应该用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词专门用来表示某个地区居民的总数。

sentences: The ___ of China is over 1.4 billion.

image_prompts: A road sign on a highway showing '50 km' to a city, with a blue sky background
A running track with distance markers, a sign reading '1 km' on the grass
words.image_desc_en: A highway sign reading '50 km'; a running track with a '1 km' marker.
words.image_desc_cn: 高速公路路牌显示‘50公里’；跑道旁草地上有‘1公里’标志。
words.meaning_cn: abbr. 千米，公里（kilometer 的缩写）
words.usage: n. (缩写，可数，复数 km 或 kms)
words.collocations: 10 km, km per hour, square km

examples.en: The school is about two km from my home.
examples.cn: 学校离我家大约两公里。

examples.en: We walked five km along the river path.
examples.cn: 我们沿着河边小路走了五公里。

socratic_questions.question: 你想说从家到公园的距离是3公里，应该用哪个缩写？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是‘千米’的常用缩写，在路牌和地图上很常见。

sentences: The bridge is 1.5 ___ long.

image_prompts: A straight road with a green signpost reading '5 km' under a clear blue sky, surrounded by fields
A running track on a sports field with distance markers every 100 meters, a white line at the 1 km point
words.image_desc_en: A road sign showing distance in kilometers, or a track with kilometer markings.
words.image_desc_cn: 显示公里数的路牌，或带有公里标记的跑道。
words.usage: n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: every kilometer, within a kilometer, kilometers away

examples.en: The school is only one kilometer from my home.
examples.cn: 学校离我家只有一公里。

examples.en: We walked three kilometers along the river path.
examples.cn: 我们沿着河边小路走了三公里。

socratic_questions.question: 你想告诉朋友你家离学校有多远，用哪个词表示距离单位？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是长度单位，等于1000米，常用于描述路程。

sentences: The park is about two ___ from the train station.

image_prompts: A line graph on a whiteboard showing a fluctuating curve with a straight dashed line labeled 'average' across the middle
A set of five test papers with scores 78, 82, 85, 90, 95 and a calculator displaying 86.0
words.image_desc_en: A graph with an average line, or a calculator showing the mean of several numbers.
words.image_desc_cn: 带有平均线的图表，或显示几个数字平均值的计算器。
words.usage: adj. / n.
words.collocations: average score, average height, on average
words.preposition_combos: above average, below average, average of

examples.en: His average score in math this term is 85.
examples.cn: 他这学期数学的平均分是85分。

examples.en: On average, it takes me 20 minutes to get to school.
examples.cn: 平均而言，我到学校需要20分钟。

socratic_questions.question: 老师把五次小测的成绩加起来除以5，得到的是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示一组数据的中间值，常用来描述一般水平。

sentences: The ___ temperature in July is 30 degrees Celsius.

image_prompts: A bicycle lying on its side on a wet road with a broken front wheel and scattered school books nearby
A cracked smartphone screen on a tiled floor with a shattered corner and glass fragments
words.image_desc_en: A damaged bicycle on a road, or a broken phone screen on the floor.
words.image_desc_cn: 路上损坏的自行车，或地板上碎裂的手机屏幕。
words.usage: n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: car accident, traffic accident, have an accident
words.preposition_combos: in an accident, by accident (注意区分)

examples.en: There was a serious traffic accident on the highway.
examples.cn: 高速公路上发生了一起严重的交通事故。

examples.en: He broke his arm in a bike accident last week.
examples.cn: 他上周在自行车事故中摔断了胳膊。

socratic_questions.question: 新闻里说两辆车在十字路口相撞，这属于什么事件？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指突然发生的、不好的、导致伤害或损失的事件。

sentences: Luckily, no one was hurt in the ___.

image_prompts: A glass of milk tipped over on a kitchen table with white liquid spreading across the surface
A stack of dominoes falling one after another on a wooden floor, the first one knocked by a rolling marble
words.image_desc_en: A spilled glass of milk on a table, or dominoes falling after a marble rolls into them.
words.image_desc_cn: 桌上打翻的牛奶杯，或弹珠碰倒多米诺骨牌的场景。
words.usage: adv. phrase (副词短语)
words.collocations: find by accident, discover by accident, happen by accident

examples.en: I found my lost key by accident under the sofa.
examples.cn: 我意外地在沙发下找到了丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: She met her old friend by accident in the supermarket.
examples.cn: 她在超市偶然遇到了老朋友。

socratic_questions.question: 你本来没想找那本书，却在书包里翻到了，这叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示事情发生不是计划好的，而是碰巧。

sentences: He broke the window ___ while playing football.

image_prompts: A calendar on a wall with a red circle around a date, a clock showing 3:00 PM nearby
A mailbox with a letter partially sticking out, sunlight casting a long shadow on the ground
words.image_desc_en: A calendar with a circled date and a clock; a mailbox with a letter and long shadow.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历上圈出一个日期，旁边有钟表；邮箱里露出一封信，地面有长影子。
words.usage: v. (过去式 expected, 过去分词 expected)
words.collocations: expect to do sth; expect sb to do sth; as expected

examples.en: I expect to finish my homework before dinner.
examples.cn: 我期待在晚饭前完成作业。

examples.en: She expects good grades from her hard work.
examples.cn: 她期望自己的努力能换来好成绩。

socratic_questions.question: 你明天要考试，心里想着可能会考哪些题目，这种心理活动叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示对未发生事情的推测或盼望，常接不定式或从句。

sentences: We ___ the bus to arrive at 7:30 every morning.

image_prompts: A shiny silver spoon resting on a dark wooden table, reflecting light
A silver medal placed on a red velvet cushion, with a soft spotlight above
words.image_desc_en: A shiny silver spoon on dark wood; a silver medal on red velvet under a spotlight.
words.image_desc_cn: 深色木桌上放着一把闪亮的银勺；红色天鹅绒垫上放着一枚银牌，上方有柔光。
words.usage: n. / adj.
words.collocations: silver medal; silver lining; silver jewelry

examples.en: She wore a beautiful silver necklace to the party.
examples.cn: 她戴着一条漂亮的银项链去派对。

examples.en: The silver moon shone brightly over the quiet lake.
examples.cn: 银色的月亮在宁静的湖面上明亮地照耀。

socratic_questions.question: 运动会上得了第二名，奖牌是什么颜色的？这种金属颜色常用来形容什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 第二名奖牌的颜色，也是贵金属的一种，常用来形容闪亮的浅灰色。

sentences: The ___ ring on her finger sparkled under the sunlight.

image_prompts: A jacket turned inside out, showing a soft fabric lining with a plaid pattern
A dark cloud with a bright silver edge glowing behind it in a blue sky
words.image_desc_en: A jacket inside out with plaid lining; a dark cloud with a bright silver edge in the sky.
words.image_desc_cn: 一件翻过来的夹克，露出格子图案的内衬；天空中乌云边缘透出明亮的银光。
words.usage: n.
words.collocations: silver lining; jacket lining; coat lining

examples.en: The coat has a warm wool lining for winter.
examples.cn: 这件外套有温暖的羊毛内衬，适合冬天。

examples.en: Every cloud has a silver lining, so don't worry.
examples.cn: 每朵乌云都有银边（坏事中总有好的一面），别担心。

socratic_questions.question: 你最喜欢的书包里面有一层布保护书本，这层布叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指衣服或包内部的那层材料，常用来比喻困境中的希望。

sentences: The bag has a waterproof ___ to keep things dry.

image_prompts: A stormy sky with dark clouds, but a narrow strip of bright silver light breaking through at the horizon
A broken pencil lying on a desk, with a sharpened tip and a small eraser still usable
words.image_desc_en: Dark storm clouds with a silver light strip at horizon; a broken pencil with a usable tip and eraser.
words.image_desc_cn: 暴风雨的乌云中，地平线处有一道银色光芒；一支断铅笔，笔尖和橡皮仍可用。
words.usage: n. (固定短语)
words.collocations: every cloud has a silver lining; find a silver lining
words.preposition_combos: silver lining in; silver lining of

examples.en: Even after losing the game, we found a silver lining.
examples.cn: 即使输了比赛，我们也找到了一线希望。
